title: World Bloom — Ordinary, Yet Special Us — Episode11 What Will Never Change

meta.Event Outline: Things have been going well for Leo/need since their professional debut. One day, a change in the tree in their SEKAI brings them to a dream world—one where they never became estranged.

rows.Line: School SEKAI
Station

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika, girls...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...!
Ichika?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Where are we...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Th-Thank goodness! You're all finally awake!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, what's going on?!
Awake? What happened?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You don't remember?
Ichi tried to take the black things off the tree.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But then they suddenly went all whoosh!
After that, you all fell asleep!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: While standing?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's what you're focused on?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In any case, thank goodness you're all okay...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, we feel fine. Thank you all for being so concerned...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of the tree, what happened to it? Is it okay...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The tree? So, nothing seems to have...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
No, wait...
Those black things are all gone now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, she's right!
All this light's gathering on it now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those are some very powerful feelings...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Everyone! Get back from the tree!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That was scary...
What just happened?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, I thought I just saw the tree absorb all of those sparkling objects...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, whoa...!!
The tree...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's grown quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, does this mean...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those objects were all fragments of their feelings.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: More to the point, they must be the true identity of those black things that were stuck to the tree.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, they were black fragments of feelings?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Not only that, of our feelings?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So, girls...
Do you remember what your dream was about?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That may provide us with some clues.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I remember. Umm...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, in your dream, the four of you were all leading completely different lives.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: In the real world, I was in the hospital for most of junior high. But in that dream, I got to pretty much go like normal.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We even got to go on that school trip together...
That was really fun.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What if...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Those black fragments may've represented the feelings the four of you felt when you'd all become separated. Sadness, loneliness, pain...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's certainly a possibility.
I mean, they didn't exactly give off a happy vibe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wait, what are you two talking about?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, for example, during that time, did these kinds of thoughts ever cross your mind?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
“Why do I have to endure this pain?”
“Why do I have to suffer like this?”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
“I wish we could spend more time together.”
“I wish they were all here with me.”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Something tells me that the negative emotions within all of you coalesced to form those black fragments.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, and touching those black fragments...
It's why their dream was about being together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, I get that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But we would've ended up going our separate ways if we stayed in that dream world, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Still, that really frustrates me...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The me in that dream had no idea just how precious the time we got to spend together was...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That me just kept believing that we'd get to hang out together forever.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even though that was never a guarantee at all.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm actually a little glad that we all had a chance to see that dream...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Because we clearly wanted to be with each other regardless of where we were or what we were doing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't think that's ever going to change for us.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree. Us making that realization is a good thing...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We all had to go through some pain and tough times, and had a lot to deal with.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The four of us get to be in a band together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which makes me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Like we just said, it was thanks to you that we decided to get our band back together in that dream.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You brought us all back together. Again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I don't think that's quite right.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You deserve a lot of credit for trying so hard to turn your feelings into a song for “me”. You're the reason “I” was able to reach them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, please let me take this opportunity to say...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for entrusting your most precious feelings to “me”.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you for bringing us all back together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thanks, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course...!

rows.Speaker: Movie
